relationships.subject: rACC-vlPAG circuit
relationships.evidence_quote: The rACC<sup>CaMKII</sup>-vlPAG neural circuit is involved in the regulation of neuropathic pain and long-term cognitive dysfunction.

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: 2 Hz EA may intervene in neuropathic pain and cognitive impairments by inhibiting the rACC<sup>CaMKII</sup>-vlPAG neural circuit.

key_findings: Inhibiting the rACC CaMKII-vlPAG circuit alleviated SNI pain and cognitive impairment, whereas activation did not.
2 Hz EA relieved both, and circuit activation reversed EA effects.
